entries.text: Rex made the first leaf bed.
Zean worked a hide until it stayed soft. They watched it happen.
Rex brought down the first hopper: fresh meat.
The village can now raise a hide teepee (hide stretched on poles): the design is in the Blueprints panel.
Lair saw a seed come up where food had rotted, and understood. They watched it happen.
Zean twisted fibre into cord. They watched it happen.
Ket saw that a hopper will stay where it is fed, and understood. They worked it out with their own hands.
The first room was closed in: 24 cells, roofed.
The first enclosed shelter stands: 24 cells, 6 beds, warmth +0.34.
Bral was born to Ne and Bal.

curio.text: A small hopping creature that bolts the moment anyone comes close. It might be good eating.
Old worked stones, half buried in the ground. Somebody made these, and they are gone.

A great sheet of still water, far wider than the stream at camp.
